newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures market closed for holiday.

text.p: The SIMEX Nikkei futures market is closed for a Japanese holiday on Wednesday. Trading will resume on Thursday.
On Tuesday, the benchmark Nikkei 225 March contract recovered most of its early losses to close 50 points lower at 18,055 after falling as low as 17,430.
Dealers said most participants were still bearish despite selected buying of blue-chip stocks, which spurred a partial recovery in the Nikkei share average.
March MSCI Taiwan index futures dipped to 305.8 at 0130 GMT on Wednesday against an opening 306.0. Volume was a low 86 lots. -- Sonali Desai (65-8703090)
